description:
Simultaneous breaks: find which symbols in a basket broke their setup bar in the same
    direction in the same bar (2d-2u, 1-2u, 3-1-2u up / 2u-2d, 1-2d down). Quant price action
    and sector rotation from your own OHLC data, no third-party feed.

    Docs: "A simultaneous break is multiple correlated assets breaking 2 in the same direction
    at the same time." No threshold: the count and the % of the basket, ranked. At 80%+ the
    group gets the label "80%+ concentration: evidence of algorithmic buying (selling) in this
    group". Returns a ranked list per direction with count, % of basket,
    symbols, and per symbol the trigger, target and level of reclaim, plus the as-of time
    and a `text` line to quote.

as_of.description: Optional ISO time. Use only bars that start at or before this time (replay a past bar).
as_of.title: As Of

basket.description: Bars per symbol on ONE timeframe, oldest first: {"XLE": [...], "XOM": [...], ...}. Same bar format as find_signals. Limits: 60 symbols, 500 bars per symbol (10 to 50 are enough). Swing: a sector ETF + its holdings on W. Intraday: SPY QQQ DIA IWM on 30 or 60.
basket.title: Basket

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Decides if the last bar is still open. Default: the server clock.
now.title: Now

strict_setup_bar.description: True (default): count only the setup bars on the owner list (2d green / 2d hammer for longs, 2u red / 2u shooter for shorts, inside bars both ways). False: any docs reversal setup.
strict_setup_bar.title: Strict Setup Bar

timeframe.description: Timeframe of the bars: 5, 15, 30, 60, D, W, M, Q or Y.
timeframe.title: Timeframe

name: sim_breaks
